主要内容: On February 5, 2014, Estée Lauder Companies Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2013. The release included the company's estimates for its fiscal 2014 third quarter and full year net sales and diluted net earnings per common share. Additionally, the company announced a dividend of $0.20 per share on its Class A and Class B Common Stock, payable in cash on March 17, 2014, to shareholders of record as of February 28, 2014. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
